description: Cross-sections of the client's pending atoms and ions added by rendering plan R08's R08.T4.h (decision-r08-t4ef-storage and its addendum of 2026-10-19), beside bounds.json: per species and task, its 1 nm cell-mean cross-sections over 380-760 nm at its source's temperature nodes, cellMeansM2, m2 an absorber, one row of 381 cells a node, the cells centred on 380, 381, ..., 760 nm, each [nm - 0.5, nm + 0.5) on vacuum wavelengths, rounded up to 3 significant figures so that each stays a bound: the interim entries of the atoms and ions R08.T4.e draws, and the entries above their limits of the ions stated none below them. Reduced values from R. L. Kurucz's atomic line lists and, for Zn+, NIST ASD's Zn II lines with their levels from Martin and Kaufman 1970 and their transition probabilities as its entry's source states, each with its citation, written by apps/hyperion/scripts/atmosphereData.mjs atomic-bounds. R08.T10.a bounds each channel's change by them at each body's own column.

Stand. 74A (1970) 11, Table 2 (read 2026-10-19 in NIST's open copy), the vacuum wavelengths their differences; A from ASD for 7 lines (5p-7s, 5p-5d, 4d 2D3/2-4f and 4d 2D5/2-4f 2F7/2), whose primary paper ASD cites, R. Mayo, M. Ortiz and J. Campos, Eur. Phys. J. Nandy and B. K. Sahoo, Mon. Not. R. Astron. Soc. 447 (2015) 3812, DOI 10.1093/mnras/stu2707, Table 10 for 5 (5s-5p, 5p-6s, and 4d 2D5/2-4f 2F5/2, which ASD gives no A); a computed line strength from R. Kisielius et al., Astrophys.
